006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.format;
007
008import java.util.stream.Collectors;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IAssemblyInstanceGroupedNodeItem;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IAssemblyNodeItem;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IDocumentNodeItem;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IFieldNodeItem;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IFlagNodeItem;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IModuleNodeItem;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IRootAssemblyNodeItem;
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
018
019/**
020 * This interface provides an implementation contract for all path formatters.
021 * When {@link #format(IPathSegment)} is called on a formatter implementation,
022 * the formatter will render the path segments based on the implemented path
023 * syntax. This allows a collection of path segments to be rendered in different
024 * forms by swapping out the formatter used.
025 *
026 * A path formatter is expected to be stateless and thus thread safe.
027 */
028public interface IPathFormatter {
029  /**
030   * A path formatter that produces Metapath-based paths.
031   */
032  @NonNull
033  IPathFormatter METAPATH_PATH_FORMATER = new MetapathFormatter();
034
035  /**
036   * A path formatter that produces XPath 3.1 paths with EQName-qualified names.
037   * <p>
038   * This formatter generates namespace-qualified paths using the EQName format
039   * (e.g., {@code Q{http://example.com}element[1]}), suitable for use with XML
040   * tooling that requires namespace qualification.
041   *
042   * @see XPathFormatter
043   */
044  @NonNull
045  IPathFormatter XPATH_PATH_FORMATTER = new XPathFormatter();
046
047  /**
048   * A path formatter that produces RFC 6901 JSON Pointer paths.
049   * <p>
050   * This formatter generates JSON Pointer paths suitable for use with JSON
051   * tooling and JSON-based error reporting. Uses JSON property names, 0-based
052   * array indices, and proper RFC 6901 escaping.
053   *
054   * @see JsonPointerFormatter
055   * @see <a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6901">RFC 6901 - JSON
056   *      Pointer</a>
057   */
058  @NonNull
059  IPathFormatter JSON_POINTER_PATH_FORMATTER = new JsonPointerFormatter();
060
061  /**
062   * Format the path represented by the provided path segment. The provided
063   * segment is expected to be the last node in this path. A call to
064   * {@link IPathSegment#getPathStream()} or {@link IPathSegment#getPath()} can be
065   * used to walk the path tree in descending order.
066   *
067   * @param segment
068   *          The last segment in a sequence of path segments
069   * @return a formatted path
070   * @see IPathSegment#getPathStream()
071   * @see IPathSegment#getPath()
072   */
073  @SuppressWarnings("null")
074  @NonNull
075  default String format(@NonNull IPathSegment segment) {
076    return segment.getPathStream().map(pathSegment -> {
077      return pathSegment.format(this);
078    }).collect(Collectors.joining("/"));
079  }
080
081  /**
082   * This visitor callback is used to format an individual flag path segment.
083   *
084   * @param flag
085   *          the node to format
086   * @return the formatted text for the segment
087   */
088  @NonNull
089  String formatFlag(@NonNull IFlagNodeItem flag);
090
091  /**
092   * This visitor callback is used to format an individual field path segment.
093   *
094   * @param field
095   *          the node to format
096   * @return the formatted text for the segment
097   */
098  @NonNull
099  String formatField(@NonNull IFieldNodeItem field);
100
101  /**
102   * This visitor callback is used to format an individual assembly path segment.
103   *
104   * @param assembly
105   *          the node to format
106   * @return the formatted text for the segment
107   */
108  @NonNull
109  String formatAssembly(@NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem assembly);
110
111  /**
112   * This visitor callback is used to format an individual grouped assembly path
113   * segment.
114   *
115   * @param assembly
116   *          the node to format
117   * @return the formatted text for the segment
118   */
119  @NonNull
120  String formatAssembly(@NonNull IAssemblyInstanceGroupedNodeItem assembly);
121
122  /**
123   * This visitor callback is used to format a root assembly path segment.
124   *
125   * @param root
126   *          the node to format
127   * @return the formatted text for the segment
128   */
129  @NonNull
130  String formatRootAssembly(@NonNull IRootAssemblyNodeItem root);
131
132  /**
133   * This visitor callback is used to format an individual document path segment.
134   *
135   * @param document
136   *          the node to format
137   * @return the formatted text for the segment
138   */
139  @NonNull
140  String formatDocument(@NonNull IDocumentNodeItem document);
141
142  /**
143   * This visitor callback is used to format an individual metaschema path
144   * segment.
145   *
146   * @param metaschema
147   *          the node to format
148   * @return the formatted text for the segment
149   */
150  @NonNull
151  String formatMetaschema(@NonNull IModuleNodeItem metaschema);
152}
